content.text:
Implemented refined Runner config page: whole roster row now clickable with keyboard and listbox accessibility while preserving test ids; directory fields auto-populate from runner heartbeat facts with Runner default hint and single Save without double-confirm; model selection replaced text box with toggle list over union of advertised/effective models plus custom add and Re-detect button backed by new POST `/runners/:id/commands` delivery via heartbeat `pendingCommands` and `refreshDiscoveredModels`; Update now button appears only when `updateAvailable` and queues an idle-only self-update via same command channel; backend `RunnerRegistry` stores pendingCommands and exposes them in heartbeat, daemon handles both commands and reports effective directories. Added helpers `effectiveDirectories`, `modelUnion`, staleness, status labels and search filter when many runners, plus revoke confirmation and clearer status badges.

KAINBAIN_VERDICT: PASS
